subject: QuickSettle pilot: onboarding checklist, PO activation timing, and settlement cadence
messages:
From: Elena Cruz <elena@nebula-supplies.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, procurement@redwood.ai
Cc: Marcus Bradley <marcus@nebula-supplies.com>
Date: Wed, 09 May 2028 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding + quick-settlement option request

Hi Rishi / Redwood procurement team,

Thanks for the greenlight to start the vendor setup. Attached are our completed vendor onboarding form and W-9. A couple of items we wanted to flag up front so we can get PO activation and invoice flow aligned quickly:

- Preferred default terms: Net 30. We can do Net 45 for certain OEM/catalog orders, but prefer Net 30.
- We’d like to opt into your QuickSettle pilot if eligible — we can do Net 15 in exchange for a 2% early-settlement deduction. This helps our cash flow while giving Redwood a small discount.
- Please confirm required banking docs (ACH letter, voided check) and whether you need a specific invoice header (PO#, billing contact, remit address).
- Expected PO activation lead time after forms received? We typically need POs to be issued within 5–7 business days to hit our production schedule.

Attachments: nebula_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, nebula_w9.pdf

Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful — Marcus and I can make time this week.

Best,
Elena Cruz
Vendor Operations Manager
Nebula Supplies
elena@nebula-supplies.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Cruz <elena@nebula-supplies.com>
Cc: chloe_martin@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, procurement@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 09 May 2028 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding + quick-settlement option request

Elena — thanks for sending these over and for the QuickSettle note.

Quick answers up front:
- We received the onboarding form and W-9, thanks.
- PO activation typically takes 3–8 business days once procurement has vendor bank details and the PO intake mapping is complete.
- The QuickSettle program is handled by Finance and requires a short addendum and a one-month reconciliation pilot. Chloe / Lauren — can you confirm the eligibility checklist and whether Nebula fits the pilot profile?

Elena / Marcus: could you also send a sample invoice (PDF) showing your preferred header and whether you include SKU-level detail vs consolidated lines? That will help us validate mapping for our AP system.

Proposed next steps:
1) Vendor to provide ACH letter and one sample invoice (Elena)
2) Procurement to validate PO intake fields with sample invoice (Chloe)
3) Finance review QuickSettle addendum and pilot terms (Lauren)
4) Issue initial PO (Rishi / Procurement)

If we can get the docs today, procurement and finance will try to expedite and aim for PO issuance by EOB Thursday.

Thanks — talk soon.

Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Cruz <elena@nebula-supplies.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, procurement@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 10 May 2028 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding + quick-settlement option request

Hi Elena — welcome, and thanks for the paperwork. I own vendor intake and will run the PO mapping. A few clarifications from the procurement side: 

1) Banking: we need an ACH authorization letter and a bank verification letter (sample attached is fine). Please redact account numbers in the public copy if needed, but finance needs the full details for the secure intake flow.
2) Invoice header: PO# (required), Invoice Date, Invoice Number, Line-item description, Unit Price, Quantity, and Tax breakdown. If you send SKU-level lines, we’ll map SKUs to our internal product codes; otherwise consolidated lines are okay but may require manual review.
3) GL mapping: please indicate the spend category for initial POs (e.g., Office Supplies / Hardware / Services). That helps us pre-populate the PO lines and speed AP coding.
4) Terms: our standard onboarding cadence for new vendors is Net 45 while we complete KYC and initial reconciliation. That said, QuickSettle pilots are evaluated on credit history, invoice accuracy, and vendor verification.

Attached: PO_Intake_Template_v2.xlsx (fillable) — can you complete and return? Also please attach vendor bank letter when ready.

If the vendor can complete the intake and provide the sample invoice by EOD today, I can complete the initial validation tomorrow and push the PO through for Rishi to issue.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Senior Procurement Coordinator
Redwood Inference
chloe_martin@redwood.ai
From: Elena Cruz <elena@nebula-supplies.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Marcus Bradley <marcus@nebula-supplies.com>
Date: Fri, 11 May 2028 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding + quick-settlement option request

Thanks Chloe — attached: completed PO_Intake_Template_v2.xlsx, sample_invoice_0428.pdf, and a bank verification letter. I’ve also re-attached the W-9.

A couple of notes on the sample invoice: we include SKU-level details and unit pricing by default; invoice includes PO# placeholder which we’ll populate when the PO is provided.

On QuickSettle: we are happy to participate in a one-month pilot. Our accounting team is comfortable with the 2% early-settlement deduction for Net 15. If finance wants to formalize this, Marcus can sign the addendum via DocuSign.

Attachments: PO_Intake_Template_v2.xlsx, sample_invoice_0428.pdf, nebula_bank_letter.pdf, nebula_w9.pdf

Best,
Elena
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, Elena Cruz <elena@nebula-supplies.com>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2028 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding + quick-settlement option request

Elena / team — Finance here. QuickSettle approval notes and next steps: 

- Eligibility: vendor must pass KYC, provide valid ACH verification, and complete the PO intake template with SKU detail for at least one invoice. Those items are complete in the thread (thanks).
- Pilot terms: Net 15 settlement in exchange for a 2.0% early-settlement deduction applied at payment. Redwood will remit the Net 15 amount based on verified invoice totals after one month of reconciliation.
- Operational notes: for the pilot we will require a single PO and up to 3 invoices to validate matching and GL mapping. After reconciliation, Finance will issue payment via ACH.
- Documents: I’ve created the QuickSettle addendum and sent a DocuSign link (https://docusign.net/signed/NDQ-7783). Please have Marcus sign. Once signed, Procurement will finalize the PO and we’ll target payment in Net 15 from invoice receipt.

Elena — assuming Marcus signs today, we can onboard you into the pilot and issue PO #RS-8471 by EOD Tuesday. Please confirm acceptance and I’ll monitor the DocuSign.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
[DocuSign audit trail note appended automatically when signed: signed_quicksettle_addendum_docusign.pdf attached]
